name: rdColormap_Load
comment: RDroid/Engine/Rdcolormap.c: allocates a 0x350-byte colormap and loads it from the named .CMP file

name: rdColormap_LoadEntry
comment: Reads the CMP header (flags, tint), the 768-byte palette, the 0x10000-byte light-level table and optional 0x8000-byte transparency table. Falls back to the grey ramp when the magic is wrong.

name: rdColormap_BuildGreyRamp
comment: Fills the colormap with the synthetic GREYRAMP.CMP palette and 64 light levels

name: rdColormap_Build16bitTables
comment: Converts the 256-entry palette into 16-bit pixel values for 64 light levels using the pixel-format shifts

name: rdroid_Startup
comment: RDroid library startup: stores the service table and builds the reciprocal/fixed-point tables

name: rdroid_Open
comment: Sets the default render state (geometry/lighting modes) and initialises the rasterizer caches

name: rdroid_BuildMathTables
comment: Fills the 1/n float table and its fixed-point twin used by the span rasterizer

name: rdCanvas_InitEdgeTables
comment: Clears the per-scanline edge buckets for the current canvas height

name: rdCanvas_ScanConvert
comment: Rdcanvas.c: active-edge scanline loop over all queued polygons; merges edges per scanline, emits spans, flushes them

name: rdCanvas_EmitSpans
comment: Walks the active edge list for one scanline, computing 0x2c-byte span records with interpolated z/u/v/light

name: rdCanvas_FlushSpans
comment: Calls each polygon's span-draw callback for its accumulated spans and resets the span buffer

name: rdCanvas_BuildEdgeLists
comment: For every queued polygon, runs its edge-setup callback on each edge and inserts the edges into the per-scanline buckets
